Forte orientamento consulenziale e capacità di comprendere le esigenze del cliente trasformandole in soluzioni concrete e ad alto valore aggiunto. Develop Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, Pulumi or similar. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation. Support cloud applications, containers and production environments. Implement monitoring, logging and alerting to improve platform reliability. Due to the nature of the project, you must be based in Australia with full, unrestricted working rights. Australian Permanent Residency is the minimum requirement; Australian Citizenship is preferred. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Ready to build, own and make an impact? If you’re a hands-on DevOps or Cloud Engineer who enjoys technical ownership, automation, problem-solving and working with modern cloud technologies, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and join the Concentrix team.
